free_tier.stated: Linux VPS at USD 5.00 per month: 2 CPU cores on Intel Xeon Gold, 4 GB ECC RAM, 20 GB SSD, 1 TB a month of transfer, 10 Gbps uplink. The next plan is USD 7.00 for 6 GB ECC and 2 TB. The tracker lists the same plan at the same price in Dallas, Los Angeles and Amsterdam; the vendor page states the specs and not the locations.

chaining: 4 GB of RAM and 2 cores for USD 5 with three U.S. and EU locations is the cheapest way to run a database or an index that must sit near the data, and the 1 TB allowance is enough for a metadata crawler that does not stream bodies

limits.value: 1 TB a month on a 10 Gbps uplink. The port is ten times what the allowance can carry in a day of sustained use, so the monthly byte count is the binding constraint rather than the link speed.

wave2.merged_note: Storage VPS on HGST enterprise HDD in RAID10, 10 Gbps uplink, six locations. Printed in two units: 100 GB for USD 40.00/year, 250 GB for USD 60.00/year, then monthly - 500 GB USD 7.00, 750 GB USD 11.00, 1 TB USD 14.00, 2 TB USD 28.00, 3 TB USD 42.00, 4 TB USD 56.00.
